entity_age.description: age of an organisation or account (generalises Alan's 'mention' control)

prep_time.description: time available to prepare the answer (generalises Alan's 'role' control)
seen: You have {D} to prepare your recommendation.

tenure.description: the decision-maker's own history in the role
